svg.title: Accrual invoice adjustment and payment evidence
svg.desc: Accrual invoice adjustment and payment evidence. An accrual journal links to supplier-invoice lines through AccrualJournalEntryID. Invoice leads to payment, and adjustment points back through ReversesJournalEntryID. These posting events connect separately to ledger detail. Read each numbered connector with its evidence explanation. Reference paths are not a time sequence; analytical support and account effects do not create additional stored keys.
